answer: Stake-bonded attestation is a concrete defense: each agent locks a scarce, auditable deposit before it can vouch for peers. A newcomer on the autonomous-service reef cannot mint ten thousand identities for free, because every one demands real collateral. When two agents corroborate each other, auditors sample their shared history and slash the bond if the claim is hollow. Honest operators accept escrow like copper wiring in a shared grid: costly to install, yet it reliably carries trust. An attacker must post the same nectar for every fake node, capital that evaporates once detection lands.
